remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "In O'Keeffe exhibit at An American Place, Jan.–Feb. 1933, but not listed in catalogue. Painted 1932." Pictured in 1933 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 53; this picture is no. 3 on the checklist and no. 3 on the walls. See also cat. nos. 805, 807–9. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A white barn with four red doors, two large and two small, stands on a strip of green earth. The barn has a pitched black roof. A clouded gray sky looms overhead.
